To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we propose PermaKey which is a novel approach to object keypoint representation learning that leverages the predictablity of local regions from spatial neighbourhoods, 2) PermaKey learns object keypoints that correspond to salient object parts, and is robust to visual distractors, 3) agents equipped with PermaKey keypoints outperform those with competing alternatives on downstream RL tasks.

1) we propose an approach to object keypoint learning based on the spatial predictability of local regions in images, and 2) we show that this approach outperforms competing alternatives on RL tasks in the domain of Atari games.
